Text: Then of course, loops are all the rage, so you should know that Grok Build has /loop built in

I often call this, agentic cron.

Use this when you want to check on things periodically. Pick an interval you want it to run, and your prompt runs, each time it's a fresh agent turn.

And yeah, you can go nuts here with up to 50 active loops, but maybe don't get that carried away.
